history.perspective: B10 - Deep link (ummahlibrary://) handling, including malformed links
history.outcome: BUG FOUND AND FIXED: setLastRead(n) fired before validation in SurahReaderScreen, letting a malformed deep link (e.g. surah/9999) poison the persisted continue-reading surah. Fixed by gating it with the same validity check used two lines below. Live-verified both the fix and the regression case.
